content: 1. Emphasize the consumption of minimally processed, nutrient-dense carbohydrates, particularly those that are high in fiber. Aim for at least 14 grams of fiber per 1,000 kilocalories consumed. 2. Limit the intake of sugar-sweetened beverages and instead encourage the consumption of water or low-calorie alternatives. This approach supports better glycemic control and promotes cardiovascular health. 3. Provide individualized education on the effects of carbohydrates, tailored to the specific needs of the person. This helps optimize insulin dosing and improves overall glycemic management. 4. For individuals using insulin, it is essential to educate them on maintaining consistent timing of carbohydrate intake. This practice helps minimize the risk of hypoglycemia.
